summary: This is a preliminary prospectus supplement filed under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered public offering of common stock by Cytokinetics Inc. The company is offering $650 million of its common stock, with an underwriters' option for an additional $97.5 million. The last reported sale price on May 4, 2026, was $66.05 per share. The offering is a standard shelf takedown, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The underwriters include Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, and Jefferies. There are no event-driven or activist elements, and the filing is routine capital raising.
